# PaintFE v1.4.11

This update focuses on startup performance and a smaller download.

## Performance improvements

Settings now save in the background, preventing disk writes from holding up the interface. AI availability checks also run in the background, GPU setup is deferred, and colour sliders reuse cached gradients instead of rebuilding large amounts of drawing geometry.

On the development PC, measured warm startup to the first UI callback improved from about 688 ms to 382 ms. Results will vary by system.

## Smaller core executable

The Windows executable is now 43.29 MiB, down from 61.89 MiB, a reduction of about 30%.

The full CJK font and JPEG XL export encoder are now optional packs, managed through Preferences > Optional features. Installation requires a one-time online download, or you can import a downloaded pack. Once installed, both work offline.

JPEG XL opening remains built in. Suitable system fonts are used where available, and PaintFE offers the font pack when needed.

## Validation

655 tests passed with no failures. Ten profiling, external-runtime and documentation checks remain intentionally ignored. Clippy, formatting and shared UI control checks passed.

Existing issues remain open for users to test and confirm.
Further testing is continuing.
